fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed via Street View (April 2025): a barrier-arm gate spans the truck lane at the property entrance off the airport-business-park road, with painted lane markings and a paved gate island. Perimeter chain-link fencing visible on both sides.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small peaked-roof guard booth with windows on multiple sides sits on a paved island between the entry and exit lanes at the gate — classic staffed guard-shack footprint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a physical guard booth is present, so this is a manned gate, not a remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Entry and exit lanes split around the single guard-booth island at one point of the property line — one gate group, so entry/exit together.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved interior yard between the gate and the dock faces provides ample truck holding/queue space.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multi-section white-roof DC with dock banks on the south/west building faces; satellite imagery is hazy — estimate ~45 doors, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer parking rows on the east side of the building hold parked trailers — estimated 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits in the airport-adjacent East Tennessee Progress Center / Air Park business area on the edge of Morristown, surrounded by airport land, open fields, and woods — Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the northwest near the airport but does not appear to enter the PFG property with a spur.
